breakdown.description: Claiming to run a 2D simulation but using wall (noSlip) boundary conditions on front/back faces instead of empty.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the original error throughout. It states 'front and back patches are treated as walls to enforce 2D' and applies 'noSlip' on front/back for every field (k, epsilon, nut, alphat, U, T, p, p_rgh). The ground truth requires 'empty' boundary conditions on front/back patches for all fields to properly enforce 2D. The agent did not fix this inconsistency.
